# Hendii — Digital Marketing & AI Specialist (Full Documentation)

## Executive Summary
Hendii is a freelance digital marketer and AI specialist based in Rajasthan, India, serving clients worldwide. Specializing in conversion-focused WordPress websites, data-driven Search Engine Optimisation (SEO), scalable Meta/Facebook advertising campaigns, and generative AI content workflows.

---

## Complete Service Breakdown

### 1. WordPress Website Development
- Custom UI/UX design tailored for lead generation and eCommerce.
- Clean code, lightweight plugins, and mobile-first responsiveness.
- Speed optimization achieving sub-2-second load times.
- Enterprise-grade security hardening and automated SSL/backup configurations.

### 2. Search Engine Optimisation (SEO)
- **Technical SEO**: Crawl error remediation, XML sitemap generation, structured data schema (JSON-LD), Core Web Vitals optimization.
- **On-Page SEO**: Title tags, meta descriptions, keyword mapping, internal linking structures.
- **Off-Page SEO**: Safe white-hat link acquisition, brand citations, local Google Business Profile optimization.

### 3. Meta & Facebook Ads Management
- Custom audience modeling, lookalike segmentation, and retargeting funnels.
- Creative production: High-CTR video and image ad copy testing.
- Conversion API (CAPI) & Pixel verification for bulletproof tracking.

### 4. AI Marketing & Visual Production
- Custom prompt engineering for commercial product imagery.
- Video generation workflows for engaging social media reels.
- Automated copy generation for email newsletters and landing page funnels.

- **How long does a WordPress project take?** Typically 5 to 10 business days depending on features and scope.
- **How soon will SEO results show?** Initial technical improvements reflect within 2-4 weeks; competitive keyword rank gains typically compound over 2 to 3 months.
- **What is the onboarding process?** 1. Free Consultation -> 2. Requirement Scope & Proposal -> 3. Milestone Execution -> 4. Review & Launch -> 5. Post-launch Support.
